data.description: Tokenize: identifiers, strings, numbers, operators (=, !=, >, <, >=, <=, IN, LIKE, NOT IN, NOT LIKE), keywords (AND, OR, NOT, ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET), parentheses, lists. Handle entity IDs with hyphens (T-123). Include position tracking for error messages. Behavioral test: tests/behavioral/test_lexer.py. Unit test: tests/unit/test_lexer.py.

properties.retrospective: Lexer implemented with full tokenization. 103 tests passing. Handles entity IDs like T-123.

data.title: T-003: Implement lexer for tokenizing query expressions
